payload.summary: Drive `aicore` is proven not to be a byte-identical Project-Frankenstein mirror: same-path router/app.py has Drive git-blob 04c70818... versus frozen GitHub blob 601b4aa0..., with Drive modified 2026-08-04. Therefore whole aicore requires recursive path/hash/version reconciliation. Separately, frank-projects contains 14 application folders but sampled roots are specs/static examples/insufficient code, so they are use-case corpus rather than ClayCode execution evidence until runnable receipts exist.
actions: Level0/Harness: recursively hash Drive aicore and cluster same/changed/new/deleted paths against GitHub and rescue lineage.
FRANK: current runtime truth must bind exact runtime/source hashes; do not assume repository head equals deployed Drive state.
ClayCode: mine frank-projects for application requirements but award APP proof only after actual compile/lower/execute receipts.
ClayGraph/UnifiedDB: preserve cross-source version nodes and supersession instead of flattening divergent copies.
